title: AI-phone complete native and public operation contract
description: Discriminated native NDJSON frames and typed public executor file operations. No content/node/depth/frame ceilings. Runtime also checks matching IDs/scopes, advertised action support, current service/revision and durable request identity.

x-transport.framing: newline UTF-8 JSON; no application frame cap

x-runtimeValidation: Equal frame requestId and mutation params.requestId
Advertised action availability, actual scope and matching args
Immutable durable request IDs; conflicting bodies fail; uncertain mutation never replays
Power acquire leaseId equals original requestId; current process state is read separately from immutable historical receipt
Power scope is device/global; display-targeted wake parameters fail; no default lease expiry or hidden cap
Power event observedAt equals exact powerState.observedAt; power state remains separate from accessibility state
mkdir/remove use actual executor, observed outcome and durable mutation identity; no path allowlist
Native home resolves actual default launcher and requests ActivityOptions target display without any global fallback; observed placement independently verified
Untargeted global act requires explicit scope=device; terminal row Home never dispatches device action; plain H uses targeted home or unavailable

Power backend combines proven global wake with lease-owned nonfocusable/nontouchable accessibility-overlay hold on display0; holdDisplayId describes backend scope, not caller-targeted wake. backendHeld reflects actual required backend resources, not screen-lock ownership alone.
Broker-local snapshot never dispatches native observe; source=broker_event_cache, cached=true, original observedAt and actual readAt remain distinct
Snapshot available=false requires null state; an absent/unavailable current capture never becomes fresh success
Snapshot connection/transportGeneration/stale guard native epochs; filtered resident state cannot replace full all-display cache
Native observe full performs fresh selected-scope capture; summary may return resident data only with original observedAt, freshness=resident and actual capturePending
Observation freshness/capturePending are typed optional fields for preserved historical frames; new APK emits them explicitly, and no absence implies fresh capture
